contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

modelVersion.description: The Reality Graph version this summary projects (server-stated; reprocessing creates new versions).

projectId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

readinessDetail.description: The server's human-readable readiness supplement, when provided.

readinessStatus.description: The Assurance Engine's readiness statement for this model version, carried OPAQUE and read-only (advisory well-known values: ready, not-ready, partial, escalation-required). The client never decides, derives or lowers readiness.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.
